verdict.rationale: Milvus documents its own RBAC, which scopes the operations a user can perform at the collection, database, and instance levels. That is a direct least-privilege mechanism you could apply to an agent's identity. The pack never shows how credentials are actually issued, such as API keys or tokens, or any agent-specific guidance, so only the scoping half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented issuance of scoped API keys/tokens, agent-specific credential workflows (e.g. scoping for the MCP server), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: With RBAC, you can finely control the operations users can perform at the collection, database, and instance levels, enhancing data security.
